references.text: Moses recounts how God promised that the children, whom the people feared would be taken as plunder, would be allowed to enter the land.
The Israelites complained and said their children would be taken as plunder, to which God responds here by promising that the children will indeed inherit the land.
Confirmation that the older generation died in the wilderness while the younger generation survived to enter the land.
Reference to the fact that the generation who despised the land did not see it, in contrast to the promise that their children would inherit it.
Moses speaks of God's judgment upon the adult generation who despised the promised land.
The fulfillment of the promise when the new generation actually inherited the land under Joshua.
The psalmist describes how the Israelites despised the glorious land and did not believe in God's promise.
The book of Hebrews refers to this generation as those who were unable to enter into rest because of unbelief.
